en.title: Maximum Equal-Size Teams After Modifying at Most k Teams
en.description:
Choose at most k teams and reduce their sizes; sizes cannot be increased, and no new team can be split off. Find the maximum number of teams that end up with the same size.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n k, and the second line contains the team sizes. 1≤n≤200000, sizes are 1..10^9, 0≤k≤10^9.
hints: Sort and group teams by equal size v; the candidate is the frequency of that size plus min(k,number of strictly larger teams).
